biography.value:
Description

A hideous creature that resembles a woman with countless snakes for hair. Its accursed gaze can turn a man to stone, while its claws and voice are just as deadly in their own ways. Occasionally called a “Marid” for some reason, but it's not terribly clear what one of those would even be. - Imban

Defense

AC 23, touch 15, flat-footed 18 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +8 natural)

hp 125 [180] (12d10+60)

Fort +9, Ref +11, Will +10

Immune paralyzed, petrified, poison

Weakness earth

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee 2 claws +17 (1d4+2 plus paralysis/19-20), 5 snake bites +11 (1d4+1)

Special Attacks Bad Breath, paralysis (1d4+1 rounds, Fort DC 20), Petrifying Gaze, Screech Voice

Statistics

Str 14, Dex 19, Con 21, Int 16, Wis 12, Cha 18

Base Atk +12; CMB +14; CMD 28

Feats Dodge, Improved Critical (Claw), Improved Initiative, Mobility, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (Claw)

Skills Acrobatics +15, Climb +16, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (Dungeoneering) +14, Perception +19, Stealth +18, Survival +15; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

Languages Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Terran

Ecology

Environment dungeons, volcanic regions

Organization small group (1-3)

Treasure standard

description.value: Special attack listed in the source statblock: Paralysis.
A stheno's snake-hair allows her to see in all directions. Sthenos gain a +4 racial bonus to Perception checks and cannot be flanked.

Once every 1d4+1 rounds, a stheno can emit a 15' cone of paralytic gas as a full-round action. All creatures caught within the cone are paralyzed for 1d4 rounds, unless they make a DC 20 Fortitude save.

effect: Failed save: give the target Bad Breath: paralyzed (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.

description.value: 1/day, a stheno turns its victims to stone permanently within a 30-ft.-cone radius. Everyone within the effect must make a DC 20 Fortitude save to negate the Petrify status effect. This is a gaze attack. The save DC is Charisma-based.

effect: Failed save: give the target Petrifying Gaze: petrified (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.

description.value: 3/day as a standard action, a stheno can let out an ear-piercing screech, damaging one enemy within 30 feet and driving them mad. That enemy takes 9d6 non-elemental damage and is Confused for 1 round, a DC 20 Will save halving the damage and negating the status effect.

effect: Half damage and negates Confuse for one round.
